cleaner.label: NuGet (.NET)
cleaner.description: Global packages, HTTP cache, plugin cache and temporary folder of NuGet. Does not touch NuGet.Config, projects or the solutions' packages folders.

option.label: NuGet global packages
option.description: Removes all the packages downloaded and extracted in NuGet's global folder.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next restore (`dotnet restore` or build). Close Visual Studio and any running builds.

option.label: NuGet HTTP cache
option.description: Removes the cached feed responses and packages (v3-cache).

option.label: NuGet plugin cache
option.description: Removes the cached results of requests to credential and feed plugins (plugins-cache).

option.label: NuGet temporary folder
option.warning: Do not clean while a restore is running: NuGet uses this folder to coordinate file locks.
